description: The chart illustrates accuracy results (in percent) for two benchmarks, MMAU and MMAR, across three model/task categories shown as grouped vertical bars. The category axis is horizontal with labels reading “Instruct,” “Audio-Reasoner,” and “Qwen-2.5-Omni” from left to right, and each category contains two adjacent bars. The value axis is labeled “Accuracy (%)” and uses a linear scale with visible tick labels at approximately 10-unit intervals (10, 20, 30, 40, 50, 60, 70), with the plotted range extending to around 70%. A legend indicates MMAU as a darker blue bar and MMAR as a lighter purple bar. For “Instruct,” the MMAU (dark blue) bar is around the mid-50% range while the MMAR (purple) bar is around the low-40% range; for “Audio-Reasoner,” the MMAU bar is around the mid-to-high 60% range and the MMAR bar is around the mid-50% range; for “Qwen-2.5-Omni,” both bars reach near the top of the axis, with MMAU around ~70% and MMAR slightly below or near ~70%. The bars are not shown with explicit numeric annotations, and there is no visual emphasis such as outlines or shading beyond the two-color encoding; the categories appear in a fixed left-to-right order rather than being sorted by bar height.
